limits: Offline Node/SQLite measurement, not Cloudflare billed rows, CPU, deployed latency, or invoice prediction.
The captured database has no sports_feed table; both versions receive the same documented empty-feed stub, counted separately.
Retained game/audit rows and cached final summaries are identical across versions. Individual scheduled run rows were absent from capture, so that table is empty.
Query response bytes count JSON-serialized returned rows and exclude D1 transport metadata.
ZIP output is consumed and counted without retaining another complete output buffer. Original baseline may buffer internally.
Sampled process memory is not an absolute V8 isolate peak; module/database setup is excluded from timed export.

Numbers use the latest single run for each version, not an averaged repeated benchmark. Timing includes query-result byte instrumentation. The upgraded Node heap sample exceeded 128 MiB; this host measurement does not establish a Worker isolate failure or prove runtime headroom. Validate actual workerd separately.
